mechanism: Ibuprofen may increase deutetrabenazine exposure through CYP2D6 inhibition and reduce renal clearance, while NSAIDs increase CNS adverse effects risk in patients with movement disorders.
action: Monitor for increased deutetrabenazine side effects (sedation, parkinsonism, akathisia); consider alternative analgesia such as acetaminophen; use lowest effective NSAID dose for shortest duration if necessary.
